readings.Aries: There is a cost to being first every time. You've been paying it without accounting for it. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Taurus: The resource you've been hoarding — time, energy, affection — is not better preserved by withholding. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Gemini: The information you need exists. You have to stop seeking it and let it arrive. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: You have been protecting others from your feelings. Consider the cost of that protection. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Leo: You are visible whether you try to be or not. Make what you're broadcasting intentional. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: There is order inside the disorder. You will find it. Give yourself the time. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Libra: You've been seeing both sides so long you've forgotten which one you were on originally. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Scorpio: The investigation you're conducting on someone else — conduct it on yourself for a day. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been talking about the future in a way that lets you avoid the present. Notice this. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Capricorn: Your self-sufficiency is extraordinary and occasionally lonely. Let someone contribute. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Aquarius: You are more affected by the people around you than your detachment makes it appear. That's not a flaw. The first instinct was right.
readings.Pisces: Something in your imagination has been trying to become real. The obstacle is the translation. Start translating. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
